Definition: from G1959; carefulness, i.e. kind attention (hospitality):--+ refresh self.
BiblicalUsage: Epimeleia is care, kind attention — and Julius, the centurion, courteously entreated Paul and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself, on the voyage to Rome.
TheologicalSignificance: One courteous centurion, one visit to friends, and Paul is refreshed for the road ahead — the kindness of a stranger matters.
